name: 3822-mtbencheagle-8b-1gpu
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct as the target, with lmsys/sglang-EAGLE-LLaMA3-Instruct-8B as the EAGLE draft head. The target id is an ungated re-upload of meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct -- same weights, same tokenizer; the Meta Llama 3 Community License applies.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one node, no router and no external cache tier.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1. Single-GPU is part of the declaration; do not shard.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 240 requests with an 1800 s safety cap. Do not raise streams above 2: cuda-graph-max-bs caps graph capture there and the engine falls to eager past it.
workload: MT-Bench, first turn only, all 80 questions, materialised to configs/data/mtbench-1turn-80.jsonl and replayed in question_id order (240 requests = three passes). Prompts are the raw questions posted to /v1/chat/completions, so the server applies the chat template itself; templated they are 22 to 359 tokens, mean 76. Every request generates exactly 512 tokens (ignore_eos is on), so the work per request is fixed.
purpose: An 8B chat assistant with a draft model, answering single-turn questions with 512-token replies sequentially on one GPU.
launch:
# sglang server arguments. Flat `key: value` only -- a nested block is dropped by the reader and
# the engine would start without it. host / port / served-model-name are set at launch.

# An ungated re-upload of `meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct` (Meta Llama 3 Community License).
# Llama-3, not Llama-3.1, to match the draft head below.
model-path: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct

tp-size: 1

# float16 rather than the target's native bfloat16: the draft head declares and was trained in fp16.
dtype: float16

# EAGLE raises ValueError for any attention backend outside {flashinfer, triton}, so one must be
# named; flashinfer is the CUDA default at this commit.
attention-backend: flashinfer

speculative-algorithm: EAGLE
speculative-draft-model-path: lmsys/sglang-EAGLE-LLaMA3-Instruct-8B
speculative-num-steps: 5
speculative-eagle-topk: 8
speculative-num-draft-tokens: 64

# 2048 is what the draft head declares as `max_position_embeddings`, and at this commit both
# models take their context length from this one argument. Never binds here: 359 + 512 at worst.
context-length: 2048

# EAGLE forces `disable_cuda_graph_padding=True`, which captures every batch size 1..N, so an
# operating point at or below N stays on the graph path.
cuda-graph-max-bs: 2

mem-fraction-static: 0.7
random-seed: 42

# Set by the engine, not here: `--speculative-algorithm EAGLE` forces prefill_only_one_req,
# disable_cuda_graph_padding, disable_radix_cache, disable_overlap_schedule and
# chunked_prefill_size=-1 in `ServerArgs.__post_init__`. Do not add them as keys.
